description: Minimum Viable Transition Record format for arifOS receipts

required_fields.timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC — when the transition was recorded
required_fields.before: object — state snapshot before action (key-value pairs of measured metrics)
required_fields.action: object — what was done (tool, command, decision, human input)
required_fields.after: object — state snapshot after action (same keys as before for comparison)
required_fields.delta: object — computed change (after - before per key, or qualitative description)
required_fields.confidence: number 0.0-1.0 — how confident the system is in this transition record

optional_fields.causes: array of transition IDs that caused or contributed to this transition
optional_fields.witnesses: array of organ/tool IDs that validated the transition
optional_fields.scar_candidate: boolean — whether this transition qualifies as potential scar
optional_fields.horizon: ISO-8601 duration — how long this transition's effects are expected to hold
